verdict.rationale: Clerk documents short-lived JWT session tokens and says it manages the full session lifecycle, including active device monitoring and session revocation, with a per-device "Sign out of device" action in the user profile UI. Community reports confirm a JWT refresh mechanism exists but say it is sparsely documented outside the standard flow. Nothing evidences configurable session expiry, a backend API for programmatic revocation, or whether revocation takes effect immediately given the short-lived JWTs. Missing for 10: configurable session lifetime and expiry settings, documented token refresh mechanics, a developer-facing server-side revocation API, proof that revocation is immediate, and independent hands-on corroboration.
